ModMetaData.name: RimThemes (1.7 Unofficial)
ModMetaData.author: aRandomKiwi, Darkwood107
ModMetaData.description:
Unofficial RimWorld 1.7 port of RimThemes by aRandomKiwi. All credit for the mod goes to the original author.
Ported to 1.7 with the assistance of Claude (Anthropic AI).
Themes engine for RimWorld. Make RimWorld look as you are or as you want.
Do not use together with the original RimThemes. Source code (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/Darkwood107/RimThemes-1.7
